name: MSC WORLD: Angel of Death
source:
Naples (Italy), a week before Halloween. Jack works as a hired killer and, as usual, he was returning home after a hard night's work to get a good sleep. However, on his way he meets an extremely mysterious individual - a demon who orders him to kill five people for him. How will all this turn out for Jack and what lesson will he learn from all these stories?

[From [url=https://artem-berkutov.itch.io/msc-world-angel-of-death]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那不勒斯（意大利），万圣节前一周。杰克是一名雇佣杀手，和往常一样，他在辛苦工作一夜后回家，想好好睡一觉。然而，在途中他遇到了一个极其神秘的人——一个恶魔，他命令他为他杀死五个人。杰克将面临怎样的结局？他将从所有这些故事中学到什么教训？

[来自[url=https://artem-berkutov.itch.io/msc-world-angel-of-death]Itch.io[/url]]
